# openwrt_firewall_redirect (Resource)

A port forward / NAT redirect (`config redirect`).

Manages a `redirect` section in `/etc/config/firewall`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `dest` (String) Destination zone. (UCI option `dest`.)
- `dest_ip` (String) Internal destination address. (UCI option `dest_ip`.)
- `dest_port` (String) Internal destination port. (UCI option `dest_port`.)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the rule. (UCI option `enabled`.)
- `extra` (String) Extra raw match arguments. (UCI option `extra`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `family` (String) Address family. (UCI option `family`.) One of: `ipv4`, `ipv6`, `any`.
- `helper` (String) Conntrack helper. (UCI option `helper`.)
- `ipset` (String) Match an ipset (`!` to negate). (UCI option `ipset`.)
- `limit` (String) Rate limit, e.g. `10/second`. (UCI option `limit`.)
- `limit_burst` (Number) Rate limit burst. (UCI option `limit_burst`.)
- `mark` (String) Match firewall mark. (UCI option `mark`.)
- `name` (String) Descriptive name. (UCI option `name`.)
- `proto` (List of String) Protocols. (UCI option `proto`.)
- `reflection` (Boolean) Enable NAT loopback. (UCI option `reflection`.)
- `reflection_src` (String) Reflection source address. (UCI option `reflection_src`.) One of: `internal`, `external`.
- `reflection_zone` (List of String) Zones to reflect into. (UCI option `reflection_zone`.)
- `src` (String) Source zone. (UCI option `src`.)
- `src_dip` (String) Original destination address (DNAT) / rewritten source (SNAT). (UCI option `src_dip`.)
- `src_dport` (String) Original destination port. (UCI option `src_dport`.)
- `src_ip` (String) Source address. (UCI option `src_ip`.)
- `src_mac` (String) Source MAC address. (UCI option `src_mac`.)
- `src_port` (String) Source port. (UCI option `src_port`.)
- `target` (String) NAT type. (UCI option `target`.) One of: `DNAT`, `SNAT`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
